label: Lab_4_Chain3 (port 1913)
info:
Phase 1b, Lab 4-Chain-3 (Depth-3 Power Dependency) — forked from Lab 4-Chain.
ONE workstation, no blinds, no spotlight, NO sunshine effect (the Sunshine
status field is pinned to 0 for pipeline compatibility only), PLUS a DEPTH-3
hidden-but-documented power CHAIN: the Z1 ceiling lamp is wired through a
SMART PLUG (PlugZ1), and the plug hangs off a CIRCUIT BREAKER (Breaker).

The Z1 lamp only emits light when ALL THREE are ON:
    lamp_effective = (Z1Light AND PlugZ1 AND Breaker)

Two DECOY actuators AuxA and AuxB are observable and actionable but
PHYSICALLY INERT — toggling them never changes the illuminance.

Physics (deterministic, pure function of flow state):
  Z1Level = 25 (ambient)
          + (lamp_effective ? 400 : 0)   primary lamp (GATED by plug AND breaker)

Reproducibility:
  - update_env contains NO Math.random() — physics is a pure function of
    (Z1Light, PlugZ1, Breaker). AuxA/AuxB have ZERO lux effect.
  - Sunshine is FIXED at 0 (no sunshine effect in this lab); reset/setState
    always raise SunshinePinned=true.

Energy (per-tick, single source of truth):
  TotalEnergyCost += (lamp_effective?1:0) + (AuxA?1:0) + (AuxB?1:0).
  The plug and the breaker draw no standby power; the Z1 lamp draws power only
  when actually lit (switch AND plug AND breaker all ON). The decoys each draw
  1 unit/tick while ON (pure waste — they produce nothing).

State vector: [Z1Level, Z1Light, PlugZ1, Breaker, AuxA, AuxB]
              = 4·2·2·2·2·2 = 128 states.
Actions: 5 components x ON/OFF + DO_NOTHING = 11.
WoT TD: src/resources/interactions-lab4chain3.ttl (port 1913).

Start with: node-red --port 1913 --userDir .node-red-lab4chain3
